name: Bharati Hospital, Pune (Dhankawadi) - Main Block
note: Made-up layout, departments, people and devices for a student demo. Not the hospital's real floor plan or data.

scenarios.name: Short circuit in Store Room 3 beside the ICUs (floor 3)
scenarios.note: A store room next to intensive care catches fire; ventilated patients need two staff each. Similar in type to the 2016 Bhubaneswar hospital fire, where a store room next to an ICU burned.

scenarios.name: Equipment fire in NICU Bay 2 (floor 5)
scenarios.note: Fire starts inside a newborn unit; incubators must be moved by staff. Similar in type to the 2021 Bhandara and 2024 Jhansi newborn-unit fires.

scenarios.name: Fire in the Central Store, ground floor (smoke rises)
scenarios.note: A store fire on the ground floor; smoke reaches the stairs after the protected doors fail. Similar in type to the 2011 Kolkata hospital fire that began in a store area.

scenarios.name: Kitchen fire, ground floor
scenarios.note: Fire in the kitchen at the north-east corner of the ground floor.

scenarios.name: Fire in the Entrance Hall (main exit lost)
scenarios.note: The main entrance, the exit most visitors know, is lost. Shows what happens when people do not follow guidance.

scenarios.name: Evacuation drill (no hazard)
scenarios.note: Alarm at the start, no fire. Used for the drill check.

scenarios.name: Drill with the Main Entrance closed
scenarios.note: Same drill with the main entrance out of use. Used as the second (hold-out) drill.
